notes: Six-figure subset for v0.6 framing-test (v5-game scaffold) and axis-loading-test (v6-neutral scaffold + axes-v2). Figures span the variance regime and density tiers: Augustus (thin, contested), Stalin (dense, canonized-low), Lincoln (dense, canonized-high), Bismarck (dense, contested), Mao (dense, canonized-low), Cromwell (medium, contested). Each test pairs same cells against the v0.5 production baseline (axes-v1, v1 prompt scaffold) for matched-cell comparison.
